title: Dasakam 98 – Niṣkalabrahmopāsanam

continuity.narrative_arc: The captions guide the visual arc from Bhattathiri’s praise of the cosmic ground, through negation, creation, illusion and analogies, to the ordered universe, inner realization and refuge from time.
continuity.deity_contract: Use one serene deep-blue Guruvayurappan/Vishnu identity in murti or restrained devotional mode where the stanza requires a divine figure. Do not invent a Vrindavan youth or chapter-specific character duplicate.
continuity.bhattathiri_contract: Use the shared older clean-shaven scholar contract: lined face, horizontal sacred-ash marks and central mark, small dark hair tuft, warm medium-brown mineral skin, cream Kerala dhoti, sacred thread and modest beads.
continuity.palette_arc: Traditional matte South Indian temple mural; firm dark contours, flat mineral fields in burnt sienna, earth ochre, deep maroon, warm cream, muted olive and established indigo-blue deity skin. No gloss, metallic shine, readable text, signature, watermark, light beams or cinematic effects.
continuity.reference_policy: Each mapped intake image provides contextual subject cues only. Follow canonical Sanskrit and verbatim caption meaning; do not reproduce glossy style, source staging, text or collage composition.
